column.description:
The column, from 1, in Unicode characters (not bytes or UTF-16
units).

offset.description: The byte offset from the start of the file.

Range.description:
A span of a file. `end` is just past its last character; an empty range
(an insertion) has equal positions.

description: What `ascribe addresses move` and `retire` write with `--format json`.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

changed.description: Whether the file changed: an entry already the same changes nothing.

edits.description:
The edits that make the change, each replacing the text of its
range in the file as it was; none when nothing changed.

file.description: The file, from the project's folder: `ascribe.addresses`.

key.description:
The entry's key: a page's path from the content root, a file's path
with `#` and an id, an address starting with `/`, or a permalink,
`go:<name>`.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

table.description: The table the entry is in: `moved` or `retired`.

value.description: The entry's value: where it moved, or why it was retired.

written.description:
Whether the change was written: the MCP server's tools write
nothing, and give the edits to apply.
